item.title: Version 1.2.25 (Build 20260930)
item.description:
What's New

fix(rules): limit Telegram Web rule to browsers via browsersOnly option

The "Telegram Web" window title rule matched every app whose title

contained "Telegram", including native clients. Add a browsersOnly flag

to WindowTitleRule (checked against the known browser bundle ID sets)

and expose it as a toggle in the rule form. It is persisted only when

true, so existing rules decode unchanged.
